name: Nate Parrott
role: Product designer at Anthropic · built Claude Design
bio: Partial catalog from one public Claude blog post (no endorsement). Nate Parrott, a product designer at Anthropic who built Claude Design, describes using it to explore, iterate, and share visual ideas early—prototypes, decks, animations—before committing to build. This entry catalogs his published best practices and “make it alive” craft notes from that article only; it does not invent unpublished material.
